pending_question_never_expires.observation: An unanswered question ask stayed in GET /question with the tool part state.status='running' for the full 26-minute observation window. No expiry event on /event; the turn hangs on the ask.
pending_question_never_expires.implication: The 'ask times out' incident class is platform-side (turn abort, pod recycle, #1310 lease resolve-by-absence) — never a harness timer. Walk-away E2E must kill asks via platform mechanisms.
